improvements: Current native scene retains 1818 source building records and validates the source geometry cache; no membership count establishes architectural parity.
Physical 61.575 m street-to-first-tread approach; earlier desktop/touch 39-tread climb and persistence; Court aimed shutters; existing animated venue proof
The selected primary activity approach is accepted separately from full-scene comparison.

District fidelity pass, f9787fa (range 332ae423..346f7986): Mapped venues without a sign (clubs, hotels, hostels, banks, museums, galleries, theatres) carry their names; the sign atlas grew from 96 to 128 entries.

Fidelity pass round 2, 9824fd5 (range 94a177d5..9824fd56): Carusel, Freddo and the hidden room are declared roofed interiors (no rain or snow inside; people inside close umbrellas). The National Bank palaces are pale limestone, the Hanul Serban Voda ruins are a walk-on glass cover, mapped named venues across the old town carry name boards, and two plaques moved out of building footprints onto Lipscani.
remainingGaps: These are separate compatible runs, not one observed entry-to-top ascent; interior/stair geometry remains estimated
Complete matched independent scene, entry and architectural/reference comparison remains open; source membership and cache hits are not visual parity.
Route/controller proof does not certify every secondary activity, completed-save persistence or full phone-thumbstick coverage.

visitorGallery.notice: 5 matched walking-height viewpoints in each of four conditions, recaptured from game source 9824fd5 after fidelity pass round 2. Open any picture at its original size.
visitorGallery.setup: Production app, scene, actors, lighting and renderer at High quality, 1280 × 800. Automatic animation was paused and explicit frames rendered at fixed on-foot cameras 1.65 m above their supporting surfaces. Local simulation dates and weather were controlled; capturedAt records the real capture time.
limitations: Fixed on-foot appearance fixtures; cameras were positioned for inspection. These pictures do not establish a traversed route, activity completion, physical-phone behavior or hardware FPS.

At the Carusel entrance visitors walking through the door push the camera body 0.2–0.4 m off the fixture point (the recorded eye of each picture is the actual one), so the four entrance pictures match within about 0.4 m instead of 0.05 m. A camera 0.6 m further back was tried and rejected: visitors stood in front of the lens.
The Freddo interior is not one of the matched viewpoints: the club is closed until 22:00, so the two day conditions cannot enter it.
The screen in the sports room is its idle game surface; video playback is not demonstrated.
Viewpoint ids, positions, look and field of view are those of the 346f7986 gallery.
Night conditions are taken after the scene's night-light fade completed (recorded nightK = 1 for every night picture).
The captured High-quality frames reach 1,121,131 triangles / 191 draw calls, within the 1.5 M triangle / 400 draw-call frame budget in these frames.
Headless Chromium (Playwright), ANGLE Direct3D 11 on an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 (hardware GL, audio muted).
